title: Qwen Open Platform Launches CaiNiao Intelligent Agent: Just State Your Requirements, AI Helps You Match Shipping Solutions

content_html:
Recently, the Qwen Open Platform launched the Cainiao Intelligent Agent, which allows users to describe their shipping needs in natural language. The Cainiao Intelligent Agent can intelligently identify items, prices, and pickup times, and match suitable shipping plans and logistics companies.

On Qwen, users can simply @Cainiao or click the "dot icon" in the upper right corner of the page to access the Cainiao Intelligent Agent, or they can directly interact with Qwen. For example, if a user says, "I need to ship clothes to Shanghai, cheaper options, today's pickup," the Cainiao Intelligent Agent will intelligently match the promotional shipping service and choose a logistics platform with better pricing.

For shipping needs that are difficult to describe with standard conditions, users can also interact using everyday language. For example, "ship a mattress to Wuhan," and the Cainiao Intelligent Agent can intelligently recognize this as a large-item shipping request and recommend carriers like Debang that are suitable.

In addition to matching based on current needs, the Cainiao Intelligent Agent also supports intelligent suggestions and information filling. When a user says, "ship a package to the previous address" or "ship an urgent item to the company," the Cainiao Intelligent Agent will intelligently suggest and complete the shipping and receiving information by combining authorized address book keywords and historical shipping records, reducing repetitive input.

If users encounter any issues during the shipping process, they can directly ask the Cainiao Intelligent Agent. For example, "Can I ship sunscreen?" or "I have a heavy box of books, which courier is cheaper?" The Cainiao Intelligent Agent will provide relevant information based on rules and data capabilities.

On August 10, the Qwen Open Platform was launched, supporting partners to independently create AI intelligent agents, providing a complete service chain for users from consultation, recommendations, to fulfillment. Its first batch of partners covers more than ten fields, including logistics transportation, real estate, local life, finance, and automotive industries.

content_html_zh:
近日，Qwen开放平台推出了菜鸟智能代理，用户可以用自然语言描述自己的运输需求。 菜鸟智能代理可以智能识别商品、价格、提货时间，并匹配合适的发货计划和物流公司。

在Qwen上，用户只需@菜鸟或点击页面右上角的“点图标”即可访问菜鸟智能代理，也可以直接与Qwen进行交互。 例如，如果用户说：“我需要寄衣服到上海，更便宜的选择，今天取货”，菜鸟智能代理会智能匹配促销运输服务，选择价格更优惠的物流平台。

对于难以用标准条件描述的运输需求，用户还可以使用日常语言进行交互。 例如，“运送一张床垫到武汉”，菜鸟智能代理可以智能识别这是大件物品的运送请求，并推荐德邦这样合适的承运商。

除了根据当前需求进行匹配外，菜鸟智能代理还支持智能建议和信息填写。 当用户说出“寄包裹到以前的地址”或“寄紧急物品到公司”时，菜鸟智能座席会结合授权地址簿关键词和历史寄件记录，智能建议并完成寄件和收件信息，减少重复输入。

如果用户在运输过程中遇到任何问题，可以直接询问菜鸟智能客服。 例如，“我可以运送防晒霜吗？” 或者“我有一箱很重的书，哪个快递比较便宜？” 菜鸟智能代理会根据规则和数据能力提供相关信息。

8月10日，Qwen开放平台上线，支持合作伙伴自主打造AI智能代理，为用户提供从咨询、推荐到履约的完整服务链。 首批合作伙伴涵盖物流运输、房地产、本地生活、金融、汽车行业等十余个领域。
